statement: With MotionPlus active, SDL3.2.10 HandleStatus bypasses the direct extension-bit-change disconnect branch and can schedule a MotionPlus check. This does not make active pass-through hotplug safe: HandleButtonData sets m_bDisconnected when MotionPlus packet downstream-presence bits disagree with the cached extension type, and HandleResponse also sets it when MotionPlus sensor availability changes. UpdateDevice then removes the joystick through the same disconnect mechanism. A statement that the MotionPlus-active path never sets m_bDisconnected is incorrect. No live MotionPlus hotplug or physical acceptance follows from this source inspection.

applicability.revision: SDL consumer source; physical Wii revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. 877399b: Wii NeedsPeriodicMotionPlusCheck430-443, HandleButtonData1266-1305 (disconnect1283/1288), HandleStatus1350-1384, HandleResponse1387-1433, UpdateDevice1512-1576.
